judgement.title: APM PMS Q&A SOP: the session run on Monday 26 October 2026 on Friday 23 October's closing prices, for your session on Tuesday 27 October
judgement.heading: Xvivo | Middle Innings Core Investment, sell signal, held under your one-off in/out link | 5.05% of the fund's capital in 3 tranches | outside the order of sale: sold by the 30% tranche rule when released
judgement.markdown:
- **Industry:** Xvivo is in Healthcare. Healthcare's Industry RS was 79 at the Friday 23 October reading (53 four weeks earlier)
- **Sector:** Xvivo is in Medtech, consumables. That sector's Sector RS was 27 at the 30 September month-end (20 at the August month-end); on Friday's daily reading it was 66
  - Xvivo's sector's other companies, with their daily Stock RS: Alcon (38), Fresenius (52), Straumann (57), Sonova (94), Coloplast (51), Smith & Nephew (30), and 15 more
- **Cohort:** Xvivo is in Fast-growing niche medtech. The cohort's relative strength was 49 on Friday's daily reading (33 four weeks earlier). Xvivo's cohort's other companies: Ambu (46), Bonesupport (97), Vitrolife (50), Surgical Science (98)
- **Xvivo's charts are on Xvivo's page on the PMS Per-stock Dashboard:** https://vfhqi.github.io/ratings/pms/holding.html?t=XVIVO-SE

**What is going on, and why it matters**
- **The price move, by beta:** over five sessions Xvivo's shares fell about 11%; Xvivo's beta of 1.19 explains about 2%, so Xvivo's own move was about -10%, 1.4 times its usual size, larger than usual
  - The dated news: Xvivo's third-quarter results on Thursday 22 October beat the analysts on sales (SEK 252.6 million against about SEK 238 million) and on profit before depreciation (SEK 52 million against about SEK 46 million), with the heart system's European approval in hand since August
  - The same report said Xvivo's largest United States lung customer has approval for its own lung platform and will buy less from Xvivo, and about SEK 19 million of the quarter was timing; Xvivo's shares fell 7.8% on Friday 23 October
- **The sector:** Xvivo's sector's companies rose about 3% over the same five sessions, so the Xvivo fall is Xvivo's own
- **Your note of 17 October is still right on both counts:** Xvivo's Friday close of SEK 206.00 is about 16% below its 200-day moving average (SEK 244.02), and all three Xvivo tranches met the 30% tranche rule on 2 October
- **The analysts:** for Xvivo, Net Upgrade Breadth, sales estimates was 0% and Net Upgrade Breadth, target prices -14% at the 30 September month-end; Xvivo's Sell-side Momentum rating is F

**What it means for the position**
- **Holding:** only the 30% tranche rule's release window keeps Xvivo; three whole-holding Sell Criteria are also met, held back by your one-off in/out link
- **Selling:** Xvivo's three tranches are sold at the first session after a close at or above SEK 236.90 (15% above the lowest close since 2 October, which is Friday's SEK 206.00), or after the 63rd trading day from 2 October (around the end of December)
  - Because Friday's close is the new low since 2 October, the release level moved down from about SEK 237.13; a 15% recovery within weeks is unlikely, so the end-of-December date is now the more likely release
- **Adding:** not allowed, because Xvivo meets a Sell Criterion
- **Why Xvivo is outside the order of sale:** the 30% tranche rule sells Xvivo's tranches whatever is bought, and your one-off in/out link does not hold back a tranche sale

**What we could lose:** nothing more to Xvivo's 30% level, because Xvivo's price is already about 5% below it; Xvivo is now about 3.9% of the fund at UBS's Friday weights, against 5.05% at purchase sizes

**Experiment: which stocks Xvivo's own moves have tracked** (last 3 and 6 months)
- **Vimian** (same country of listing): 0.30 and 0.13, weak
- **Wallenstam** (same country of listing): 0.28 and 0.17, weak
- **Demant** (same sector): 0.27 and 0.18, weak
- **Camurus** (same country of listing): 0.23 and 0.13, weak
- **My reading:** Xvivo's moves are mostly its own; Xvivo's own news decides Xvivo's price

**The Investment Analyst's new memo on Xvivo (written 25 October at SEK 223.40, published 26 October; read from the memo's summary, because the new memo has no separate digest)**
- **Decided:** the new memo on Xvivo calls Xvivo "a predictable business inside an unpredictable security": the fundamentals skew positive over two to three years, while the next two to three reports skew towards estimate cuts
- **Must happen:** European heart-system sales ramping from the first quarter of 2027, the analysts resetting 2027 earnings per share down by about 25% to 35%, and the United States regulator's approach to the heart application visible by mid-2027
- **Main risk:** the analysts' 2027 and 2028 earnings are about 36% to 37% above the memo's own, because they have not yet carried the new approval's amortisation, a normal tax rate and the end of currency gains; the downside to the memo's fair trough is SEK 110 to SEK 140, about 32% to 47% below Friday's close
- **Expected return (the Modal return):** about +90% over eighteen months on the memo's own central multiple (from SEK 223.40), above our bar, but only after the estimate cuts have been absorbed
- **Next test:** Xvivo's fourth-quarter report on 28 January 2027

**My judgement:** bearish on the Xvivo position over the next three months, neutral beyond that, medium conviction: let the release rule sell it
- The rule and the new memo agree on the near term: the memo expects a run of estimate cuts that the price has only started to absorb, which is what the three Sell Criteria and the 30% fall are reading
- **Counter-case:** the memo's long-term return is far above our bar, and selling around the end of December may sell near the bottom of the estimate-cut cycle; a sale before then would need you to lift your one-off in/out link for Xvivo, which I do not recommend while Theon waits

**What would change my view:** a close at or above SEK 236.90 (which releases the tranches); the analysts' 2027 estimates falling to the memo's level faster than the memo expects

items.criterion: MA SLs: each tranche's MA less 2%, information only for a Middle Innings Core Investment

bullets.text: Xvivo is a Middle Innings Core Investment, so its MA SLs sell nothing; its six Sell Criteria decide the sale.
Xvivo's MA SL exits were confirmed for tranche 2 on 14-Jul, tranche 3 on 14-Sep and tranche 1 on 21-Sep.
Xvivo's 27-Oct close of SEK 202.0 needs a 17.3% rise to regain tranche 3's MA SL stop and a 26.3% rise for tranches 1 and 2.

items.criterion: A tranche 30% below its highest close since purchase, with Stock RS below 70

bullets.text: Xvivo's 30% fall test triggered all three tranches on 2-Oct, so all three sell at the Tuesday session after their release, which your one-off in/out link does not hold back.
Xvivo's release comes on a close at or above SEK 232.30, 15% above the 27-Oct low, or on the 63rd trading day after 2-Oct, about 5-Jan-2027.
Any 15% Xvivo rebound sells all three tranches, as SEK 232.30 comes before Xvivo's relative price clears its 52W-high line (about SEK 243.72) or regains an MA SL.

items.criterion: Relative price more than 25% below its 52W high, read at the month-end

bullets.text: Xvivo's relative price against its 52W high has been a sell signal since the 30-Sep month-end (31.5% below), and was 37.9% below on 27-Oct.
Ending the sell signal from Xvivo's relative price against its 52W high on Fri 30-Oct needs an Xvivo close of about SEK 243.72, 20.7% above the 27-Oct close.
Xvivo's relative-price, Sector RS and Stock RS sell signals have kept the whole Xvivo holding awaiting its replacement since the Tue 6-Oct session.

items.criterion: Stock RS below 50 with revenue or PT Net Upgrade Breadth below zero, read at the month-end

bullets.text: Xvivo's Stock RS with Net Upgrade Breadth test has been a sell signal since the 30-Sep month-end, deeper on 27-Oct with Stock RS 12 and revenue Net Upgrade Breadth (71%).
Xvivo's Stock RS sell signal very probably stays at Fri 30-Oct, as ending it needs Xvivo's Stock RS at 50 or more, or both breadths at zero or above.
Xvivo's Stock-specific Investment Case A&J Memo of 26-Oct expects more cuts, with FY2027 EPS consensus falling toward SEK 4.0 to 4.5 by the third-quarter 2027 report.

items.criterion: Sector RS below 50 with Stock RS below 70, read at the month-end

bullets.text: Xvivo's Sector RS test is a sell signal on 27-Oct by one point: medtech consumables' Sector RS is 49 (Framework 14 figures) and Xvivo's Stock RS is 12.
Medtech consumables' Sector RS has moved by up to 23 points a week since mid-September, so Xvivo's Fri 30-Oct reading can land either side of 50.
Even if Xvivo's Sector RS sell signal ends, Xvivo's Stock RS and relative-price sell signals keep the whole Xvivo holding awaiting its replacement.
The page's 28-Oct readings put medtech consumables' Sector RS at 60, above 50, so no Sector RS sell signal for Xvivo on that reading.

items.criterion: The 200D MA of relative price flat or falling over the month, read each Friday

bullets.text: No sell signal: the 200D MA of Xvivo's relative price rose 0.34% over the month to 27-Oct, down from 0.55% at the 23-Oct reading.
Xvivo's relative 200D MA turns down, a sell signal, by Fri 6-Nov unless Xvivo's relative price rises about 16%, and on Fri 30-Oct if it falls about 2.1%.
A relative 200D MA sell signal would add to Xvivo's other sell signals without changing what the rules do: the whole Xvivo holding stays awaiting its replacement.

items.criterion: Industry RS below 30, read each Friday

bullets.text: No sell signal: Xvivo's Industry RS (Healthcare) was 79 on 27-Oct, up from 53 at 30-Sep, with Healthcare at a 52W high.
Healthcare's Industry RS, which sets Xvivo's Industry RS, read 26 at the 7-Aug Friday reading, below the sell line of 30.

adds.criterion: The rules: no sell signal from the six Sell Criteria

bullets.text: Xvivo has sell signals from its Sector RS, Stock RS with Net Upgrade Breadth and relative price against 52W high tests, and its 30% fall test triggered on 2-Oct.
With sell signals on, the rules allow no add to Xvivo, and the whole Xvivo holding has awaited a replacement purchase since the Tue 6-Oct session.
Adds to Xvivo need all three month-end sell signals to end, but Xvivo's 30% fall trigger still sells all three tranches on release.

adds.criterion: The rules: room below the holding's limit

bullets.text: Xvivo is 5.05% of capital against the 6.68% limit for a Middle Innings Core Investment, leaving room of 1.63% of capital.
Xvivo's room of 1.63% is less than one full tranche of 1.67%, and the 6.68% limit stops adds but never forces a sale.
Any add to Xvivo would be a part tranche of at most 1.63%, as a full 1.67% tranche would take Xvivo to 6.72%, above the limit.

adds.criterion: Your add trigger: a positive retest of a rising MA

bullets.text: On 27-Oct Xvivo's SP (SEK 202.0) was 17.2% below its rising 200D MA and below its 20D, 50D, 100D and 150D MAs.
Xvivo's pullback to its rising 200D MA failed: Xvivo closed more than 2% below that MA at all 21 sessions from 29-Sep to 27-Oct.
Xvivo would first need to close back above its 200D MA (SEK 244.10), 20.8% above the 27-Oct close, before a positive retest could form.

adds.criterion: Your add trigger: a broadening of the case (momentum rising in guidance, sell-side estimates, technicals or peers)

bullets.text: For Xvivo, sell-side estimates and technicals are falling clearly while peers are rising; Xvivo said on 22-Oct its largest United States lung customer will buy less.
Xvivo's consensus FY2027 EPS fell (13.2%) in the month to 28-Oct, and Xvivo's EPS Net Upgrade Breadth read (100.0%) on 28-Oct.
An end to the sell-side's cuts, with Xvivo's Net Upgrade Breadth back to zero or above and Xvivo's Stock RS turning up, would be needed before Xvivo's case could broaden.
Your 28-Oct note leans to adding, on a condition: "there is scope to add to Xvivo if there is no company-specific negative newsflow".
Your 22-Sep note recorded Xvivo's SP fading from 310 SEK to 250 SEK, and Xvivo's SP was SEK 202.0 on 27-Oct.

Whether Xvivo's 22-Oct report (its largest United States lung customer will buy less) and the estimate cuts since are the "company-specific negative newsflow" your 28-Oct note excludes is your ruling.
